reference: Actual original capacitor wire entry 0x08057998 through join 0x08078890 return and VIA 0x08057b78 entry/return, unchanged numerical instructions. Every XYZ store, scalar width, conductor thickness, metal and explicit via count captured after rotation and native linked/direction reversal; output origin and exact incoming parsed config retained. Native uninitialized conductor mesh counts and via thickness excluded.
gdb_commands:
set pagination off
set confirm off
set environment TERM dumb
set environment INPUTRC /dev/null
break *ENTRY
run -g -t process.tek -x input.asit < answers.txt
python
import gdb,struct,json
def memory(a,n):return bytes(gdb.selected_inferior().read_memory(a,n))
def u32(a):return struct.unpack('<I',memory(a,4))[0]
def i32(a):return struct.unpack('<i',memory(a,4))[0]
def f64(a):return struct.unpack('<d',memory(a,8))[0]
control_before=int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$fctrl'))
esp=int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$esp'));ret=u32(esp);args=u32(esp+4)
config=dict(nx=i32(args+0x64),ny=i32(args+0x6c),length=f64(args+0x70),height=f64(args+0x78),width=f64(args+0x88),spacing=f64(args+0x90),turns=f64(args+0x98),angle=f64(args+0xa0),metal=i32(args+0x68),exit_metal=i32(args+0x6c),phase=i32(args+0xac),x=f64(args+0x54),y=f64(args+0x5c))
metal_count=i32(0x80d8904)
gdb.Breakpoint('*'+hex(ret),temporary=True,internal=True)
gdb.execute('continue',to_string=True)
head=u32(0x80ce558);segment=u32(head+0xa8);segments=[]
while segment:
 assert len(segments)<20000
 metal=i32(segment+0xdc)
 item=dict(coordinates_bits=b''.join(memory(segment+offset,24)for offset in(0,24,0x44,0x5c,0x88,0xa0)).hex(),width_bits=memory(segment+0xcc,8).hex(),metal=metal)
 if metal<metal_count:item['thickness_bits']=memory(segment+0xd4,8).hex()
 else:item['nx']=i32(segment+0xe0);item['ny']=i32(segment+0xe4)
 segments.append(item);segment=u32(segment+0xec)
result=dict(origin_bits=memory(head+0x54,16).hex(),config=config,origin=[f64(head+0x54),f64(head+0x5c)],segments=segments,control_before=control_before,control_after=int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$fctrl')))
open('primitive.json','w').write(json.dumps(result))
end
kill
quit
